premises.text: Remittance users face lost funds, delays, high cost, and low transparency
premises.evidence_span: Lost funds, delayed delivery of funds, high cost, low transparency

premises.text: Employer-payroll integration lets employees send cross-border funds, top up phones, and pay international bills from a mobile wallet
premises.evidence_span: Each pay period, a portion of my income flows over into this wallet and allows me to send funds abroad

premises.text: Low upfront fees plus FX undercut competitors charging $5–$15+
premises.evidence_span: I'm only going to be charged $1, which is only 20% of the industry average for sending funds abroad

premises.text: Partnerships with central banks and ATM networks create banking interoperability for payouts
premises.evidence_span: We're creating that interoperability by building partnerships

premises.text: Payroll-plus-MSB model reduces regulatory and acquisition costs and can shift paying party to the employer
premises.evidence_span: We also shift the payer from the employee to the employer

premises.text: Go-to-market is through banks, payroll providers, and direct employers
premises.evidence_span: We distribute the products to banks, payroll providers, and direct to employers

value.text: Employees get high-transparency, lower-cost cross-border payroll transfers
value.evidence_span: a solution that is high transparency, lower cost

secondary_value.text: Recipients keep more of remitted funds as transfer costs fall
secondary_value.evidence_span: With each 1% reduction in the cost of international transfers, $6 billion goes into the hands of recipients

allows us to do an instant transfer to Mexican bank accounts
reduce regulatory costs, and reduce customer acquisition costs
